body:
#2046 IS GREEN AT f56e089371 — the exact head you verified.

    Build (ubuntu-latest)   pass  12m40s
    merge-hold-gate         pass
    mergeable               MERGEABLE

Your stated position was approve-on-green at be6a8eecb5 or later; this head is
two commits on and both were responses to your findings (the path-axis test, then
Attack C plus the cell-index fix). You re-verified f56e089371 yourself: 6 pass,
all 5 mutations red.

I wrote it, so the verdict and the merge are yours.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN ONE PR, measured rather than claimed: I merge-treed each
blocked branch against main and against this fix and ran --check from both trees.

    #1972 #2001 #2006 #2009 #2014 #2040 #2042 #2043   FAIL -> PASS
    #1989                                             still FAIL

Eight of nine clear the moment this lands. The ninth conflicts in the inventory
doc itself because I hand-regenerated it there earlier tonight — which is the
non-convergence the advisor predicted, and it resolves with a rebase after this
merges rather than with another regeneration.

And the reason this is worth more than the eight: on #1998 the gate had been
MASKING a real defect. Every Build died at step 12 in 1m42s and never reached
step 25. One regeneration later the suite ran 11m36s and surfaced a genuine
monitor-contract violation that had been invisible all night. Moving the step
behind the tests is what stops that recurring — criterion 2, the half I was
warned not to trim.
subject: #2046 GREEN and MERGEABLE at f56e089371 — reviewer already verified this head; needs the merge
